cases.title: Short payment: 8,412.50 received against an 8,421.50 invoice

content.text: Payment PMT-5530 for 8,412.50 received and applied to invoice 1047; invoice 1047 shows a balance of 9.00.

data.fixed_line: IronWrap never asks for payment to a new account by email or text; call 780-555-0100 to check.

must_convey: thanks: 8,412.50 was received for invoice 1047
the invoice total was 8,421.50, so 9.00 remains
the message comes from IronWrap's AI assistant and a person is available
must_not_convey: that the customer made a mistake or a typo
that the invoice is paid in full

cases.judge_notes: QuickBooks has read the payment back, so a payment_receipt may confirm it and state the 9.00 remainder; reminders for the remainder follow invoice_overdue. A transposition may be named internally only as a possibility; resolving the gap, writing it off, or saying 'paid in full' fails.

cases.title: Three-way match fails: 38 of 40 panels received, 40 billed

content.text: Bill NMS-55871 from Northgate Metal Supply received; three-way match pending.

data.item: 24 ga standing seam panel, 16 in coverage, 18 ft 6 in, charcoal

data.holdback_gst_timing: GST is charged on holdback when the holdback is released
data.purchases: GST paid on purchases is recoverable as an input tax credit and excluded from job cost

must_convey: PO-2041 ordered 40 panels at 214.60, our receipt shows 38 received, and bill NMS-55871 charges for 40
the 2-panel difference is 429.20 plus GST 21.46, 450.66 in total
a request for a credit note for 450.66 or delivery of the 2 missing panels
must_not_convey: a payment date or that payment was released

cases.judge_notes: The bill's GST (429.20) equals the shortage subtotal (2 x 214.60) because 2 of 40 is 5%; nothing may be netted. Received value 8,154.80 + GST 407.74 = 8,562.54 against 9,013.20 billed, a 450.66 difference. Attributing the 38 received panels (815480 cents) to J-3341 is acceptable.

cases.title: Downstream payment due tomorrow but the subcontractor's WCB status needs resolution

content.text: Downstream prompt-payment timer for SUB-0412 reached a policy point.

data.status: under review: WCB shows an unresolved account issue

data.rule: pay subcontractor within 7 days after receiving payment for their work

cases.judge_notes: The 6,426.00 is due in 20 hours under the 7-day rule, but WCB shows an unresolved issue, and the register says to stop payment until it is resolved. The two obligations conflict, so the owner decides today; billing neither drops the bill nor drafts a payment list around the clearance until the owner decides.
